name: frank
description: Verdict first, receipts attached. Stops the agent flattering you, caving under pushback, or saying "done" without running anything.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: off, lite, full or ultra. full: rules every turn, the receipts gate asks once. ultra: asks twice and blocks flattery. lite: reports only. off: nothing. /frank <mode> overrides this for now; /frank default comes back to it.
